name: Simplify self-healing to match manual workflow
description: The current self-healing in FEAT-022 is complex with auto-triage, categorization, and retry loops. The user's actual workflow is simple: regression fails → copy error → Claude creates bug PRD → fixed. Simplify to match this proven pattern.

userStories.title: On regression failure, output clear error summary for copy-paste
userStories.description: When tests fail, output a formatted block that can be directly pasted to Claude Code.
acceptanceCriteria: On test failure, output includes: test name, assertion that failed, expected vs actual
Output is formatted as markdown code block for easy copy
Output suggests: 'Paste this to Claude Code to generate a fix PRD'
Remove complex categorization logic - just show the error clearly

userStories.title: Remove automatic bug PRD generation
userStories.description: Let the user/Claude Code create the bug PRD rather than auto-generating.
acceptanceCriteria: FADE no longer auto-generates bug PRDs in fade/prds/auto/
FADE halts cleanly after showing error summary
User can manually run `fade new bug` or paste to Claude Code
Remove generate_bug_prd() and related auto-generation code

userStories.title: Remove retry loop for self-healing
userStories.description: The K-attempts retry loop adds complexity. Remove it.
acceptanceCriteria: User explicitly runs `fade run` to retry after fix
Remove MAX_HEAL_ATTEMPTS and related loop logic
FADE exits with clear status: 'Regression failed. Fix and re-run.'

technicalNotes.rationale: Removing code is simpler than adding. Haiku can handle deletion and simplification.
